title: Battle of Falkirk Muir
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Falkirk Muir", at revision 1376070524, opens: "The Battle of Falkirk Muir, or Battle of Falkirk, took place near Falkirk, Scotland, on 17 January 1746 during the Jacobite rising of 1745. A narrow Jacobite victory, it had little impact on the campaign." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1417580, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1746 last noteworthy Jacobite success during the Jacobite risings". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
